self_assessment_questions.text: I believe a career is a means to an end, not a primary identity.
I am comfortable living a life that looks unconventional to others.
I see marriage (or a lifelong legal commitment) as a personal requirement.
I want to raise children in a traditional family structure.
My political/social activism is a non-negotiable part of my daily life.
I value financial security over spontaneous luxury experiences.
Religion or spirituality plays a central role in my decision-making.
I believe in total honesty, even if it might hurt my partner's feelings.
I would be willing to relocate for my partner's career or dreams.
I view personal growth as a lifelong, active pursuit.
I prefer a quiet night in over a large social gathering.
I am a morning person who likes to be productive early.
I keep my living space meticulously organized.
I am comfortable with high-risk financial investments.
Physical fitness is a daily priority for me.
I enjoy planning travel down to the last detail rather than winging it.
I am comfortable with my partner having close friends of the opposite gender.
I prefer to spend my weekends being active rather than resting.
I am a foodie who prioritizes dining out and trying new cuisines.
I value having a lot of alone time even within a committed relationship.
When I'm upset, I need space before I'm ready to talk.
I prefer to address issues the moment they arise.
I use humor to de-escalate tension during an argument.
I am comfortable with loud, passionate debates.
I rarely hold grudges once an apology has been made.
I find it easy to admit when I am wrong.
I prefer gentle communication over blunt communication.
I believe some things are better left unsaid to keep the peace.
I seek external advice (friends/family) when facing relationship hurdles.
I view a fight as a sign that the relationship needs work.
I need a partner who can challenge my opinions intellectually.
I enjoy discussing abstract concepts and philosophy.
I stay up-to-date with current events and world news.
I value witty banter as a primary form of flirting.
I enjoy attending cultural events (museums, theatre, lectures).
I want my partner to be my plus one at every social event.
I am comfortable being the center of attention in a room.
I prefer deep one-on-one conversations over group hangouts.
I find intelligence more attractive than physical appearance.
I am a lifelong learner who is always starting a new hobby or course.
Physical touch is my primary way of showing affection.
I need frequent verbal affirmation to feel secure.
I am comfortable discussing my deepest insecurities early on.
I believe love is a choice rather than a feeling you fall into.
I am highly sentimental—I keep mementoes and celebrate anniversaries.
I am very comfortable with public displays of affection.
I believe my partner should be my absolute best friend.
I am okay with a partner who is less emotional/expressive than I am.
I value acts of service (doing chores/favors) as a high form of love.
I believe in maintaining a level of mystery/independence even in long-term love.

ideal_partner_questions.text: I want a partner whose career is something they do, not something they are — if the job vanished tomorrow, they'd still know who they are.
I'm looking for someone who can build a life that looks unconventional to outsiders without needing their approval.
Working toward marriage (or an equivalent lifelong commitment) has to be something my partner actually wants, not just tolerates.
When I imagine raising a family, I need a co-parent who wants a fairly traditional structure too.
I need my partner's political or social activism to fit comfortably into our daily life together, not compete with it.
Faced with a choice between security and splurging on the moment, I want a partner who leans toward stability.
I want someone for whom religion or spirituality genuinely shapes the choices they make, not just something they mention.
Even when it stings, I need a partner who'll tell me the truth rather than soften it.
If my career or dreams required a move, I need a partner willing to relocate for them.
I'm drawn to people who treat self-improvement as a lifelong project, not a phase.
Given the choice, I want a partner who'd rather stay in with me than head to a big party.
I need someone who's up and productive early — a fellow morning person, not a night owl I have to work around.
A tidy, organized living space matters enough to me that I need a partner who keeps things that way too.
I want a partner who's comfortable taking real financial risks, not one who always plays it safe with money.
Daily exercise has to be close to non-negotiable for whoever I'm with.
When we travel, I need a partner who plans the details rather than winging it.
I need to feel completely at ease with my partner having close friends of the opposite gender.
My ideal weekends are active ones, so I want a partner who'd rather be doing something than resting.
Trying new restaurants and cuisines should genuinely excite my partner, not feel like an obligation.
Even in a close relationship, I want a partner who values having plenty of time alone.
When things get heated, I need a partner who can take space to cool off before talking it through.
I want issues addressed the moment they come up, not left to simmer — that has to be how my partner operates too.
Humor that defuses tension mid-argument is something I need in a partner.
I'm comfortable with a partner who debates loudly and passionately rather than staying reserved.
Once an apology's been made, I need a partner who can genuinely let it go rather than holding a grudge.
Being able to say "I was wrong" without a fight has to come easily to my partner.
I respond better to gentle communication, so I need a partner who leads with softness over bluntness.
I want a partner who believes some things are better left unsaid to keep the peace.
When relationship issues come up, I need a partner who's comfortable leaning on friends or family for outside perspective.
I want a partner who treats a fight as a signal the relationship needs attention, not as a crisis.
I need a partner who'll push back on my opinions and challenge how I think, not just agree with me.
Conversations about philosophy and abstract ideas should be something my partner genuinely enjoys.
Staying current on world news and events matters to me in a partner.
Witty back-and-forth banter needs to be part of how my partner flirts.
Museums, theatre, lectures — I want a partner who's genuinely into cultural outings like these.
I want my partner to be my plus one at every social event I attend.
I need a partner who's comfortable being the center of attention in a room.
Deep one-on-one conversation should appeal to my partner more than group hangouts.
Intelligence has to matter more to me than physical appearance when I'm choosing a partner.
I'm looking for a lifelong learner — someone always picking up a new hobby or course.
I want a partner whose go-to way of showing affection is physical touch.
Frequent verbal affirmation is something I need to feel secure, so I want a partner who gives it freely.
I need a partner willing to open up about their deepest insecurities early in the relationship.
I want a partner who sees love as something you choose daily, not just a feeling you fall into.
Keeping mementoes and celebrating anniversaries — I want a partner who's genuinely sentimental like that.
Public displays of affection should feel completely natural to my partner.
My partner has to be my absolute best friend, not just a romantic partner.
I'm fine with a partner who's less emotionally expressive than I am.
Acts of service — doing chores, small favors — need to be how my partner shows love.
Even in a long-term relationship, I want a partner who holds onto some mystery and independence.

rock.name: The Rock
rock.subtitle: Stability & Tradition
rock.ideal_partner_description: You want a builder. This person values 'The Plan.' They are reliable, likely family-oriented, and find safety in routine. They show love through doing (Acts of Service) and being present.
rock.self_description: You are a builder at heart. You value stability, routine, and creating something lasting. You show love through consistent actions and being reliably present. Family and tradition matter deeply to you.
rock.full_description:
The Rock represents stability, reliability, and traditional values. This archetype embodies the partner who provides a solid foundation for building a life together.

**Core Philosophy:** Life is about building something lasting. Security isn't boring—it's the foundation that allows everything else to flourish.

**What Drives Them:** A deep need for predictability and the belief that commitment is demonstrated through consistent action over time.
typical_behaviors: Arrives 10 minutes early to everything
Has a detailed calendar and enjoys planning the week ahead
Remembers important dates without being reminded
Pays bills the day they arrive and maintains an emergency fund
Prefers 'their spot' at restaurants and values regular rituals
Researches major purchases thoroughly
Keeps their word even when inconvenient
Maintains long-term friendships from childhood
green_flags: They ask about your five-year plan early on—they're thinking long-term
They show up early and follow through on every commitment
They remember details about your family and meaningful moments
They introduce you to their family and close friends
They talk about 'us' and 'we' naturally, seeing you as a team
rock.shadow_warning: You may be unconsciously drawn to highly emotional, unpredictable partners who destabilize your need for security, creating an exhausting push-pull dynamic.

challenger.name: The Challenger
challenger.subtitle: Intellect & Growth
challenger.ideal_partner_description: You want a co-pilot. This person needs to be your mental equal. They value autonomy and personal evolution. Expect deep debates and a partner who has a life entirely their own.
challenger.self_description: You are an intellectual powerhouse who values growth above comfort. You need mental stimulation and autonomy. You show love by pushing your partner to reach their potential and engaging in meaningful debates.
challenger.full_description:
The Challenger represents intellectual curiosity, personal growth, and the pursuit of excellence. This archetype keeps you sharp and refuses to let you settle for mediocrity.

**Core Philosophy:** Growth is non-negotiable. A relationship should make both people better versions of themselves.

**What Drives Them:** An insatiable curiosity about the world and belief that the examined life is the only life worth living.
typical_behaviors: Plays devil's advocate to explore all angles
Has strong opinions but changes them when presented with evidence
Always taking a course, reading, or learning something new
Asks 'why' multiple times, drilling to root causes
Maintains rich independent interests and friendships
Sends articles with 'What do you think about this?'
References things you said months ago in new contexts
Gets visibly energized during good debates
green_flags: They suggest experience dates—lectures, hiking, travel
They debate without getting offended—disagreement energizes them
They have a thriving career or passion project
They introduce you to new ideas, books, and perspectives
They maintain independence—they want you, don't need you
challenger.shadow_warning: You may be drawn to overly agreeable partners who never challenge you, leading to intellectual boredom and eventual resentment.

empath.name: The Empath
empath.subtitle: Connection & Intimacy
empath.ideal_partner_description: You want a soulmate. You're looking for high emotional intelligence and deep connection. This person is expressive, values vulnerability, and prioritizes emotional intimacy.
empath.self_description: You are deeply attuned to emotions—your own and others'. You crave authentic connection and aren't afraid of vulnerability. You show love through presence, affection, and creating safe spaces for hard conversations.
empath.full_description:
The Empath represents emotional depth, vulnerability, and profound connection. This archetype truly sees you—not just what you do, but who you are underneath.

**Core Philosophy:** Intimacy is built through vulnerability. The deepest connections require courage to be fully known.

**What Drives Them:** A need for authentic connection and belief that emotional intimacy is the foundation of lasting love.
typical_behaviors: Asks 'How are you?' and waits for the real answer
Remembers emotional details about what stresses you
Comfortable with silence—doesn't need to fill every moment
Cries at movies, weddings, and beautiful moments
Notices mood shifts before you've registered them
Gives thoughtful gifts referencing old conversations
Is the friend everyone calls for hard conversations
Processes the world through feelings first
green_flags: They use 'I feel' statements naturally
They ask open-ended questions about your inner world
They have calm, grounding energy that makes you feel safe
They sit with uncomfortable emotions without rushing to fix
They've done inner work—therapy, meditation, or journaling
empath.shadow_warning: You may be drawn to intellectually dismissive partners who make you feel your emotions are 'too much,' perpetuating a cycle of feeling unseen.

adventurer.name: The Voyager
adventurer.subtitle: Social & Lifestyle
adventurer.ideal_partner_description: You want a partner-in-crime. This person is high-energy, socially flexible, and a risk-taker. They want to experience the world with you.
adventurer.self_description: You are driven by experience and novelty. You make life feel like an adventure and believe the best memories are unplanned. You show love by creating adventures and introducing your partner to your wide social world.
adventurer.full_description:
The Voyager represents spontaneity, social energy, and the pursuit of experience. This archetype makes life feel like an adventure.

**Core Philosophy:** Life is short; fill it with stories. Experiences matter more than possessions.

**What Drives Them:** A fear of stagnation and belief that novelty keeps relationships alive.
typical_behaviors: Suggests 'Let's just go' and means it
Has friends from every phase of life
Tries the weird thing on the menu
Gets restless if weekends are too routine
Prefers passport stamps over a bigger house
Energized by crowds and social gatherings
Has stories that start with 'This one time...'
Comfortable with uncertainty—finds over-planning stifling
green_flags: They plan surprise adventures that show they know you
They're comfortable with vulnerability and spontaneity
They prioritize experiences over possessions
They're fully present when together—phones away
They make you feel like anything is possible
adventurer.shadow_warning: You may be drawn to overly rigid partners who represent 'stability' but actually stifle your spirit, leading to feeling trapped.

counter_type.name: The Homebody
counter_type.description: Finds comfort in familiar, small circles

diplomat.name: The Diplomat
diplomat.subtitle: Harmony & Communication
diplomat.ideal_partner_description: You want a peacemaker. This person excels at communication, values harmony, and has the emotional intelligence to navigate difficult conversations with grace.
diplomat.self_description: You are a natural mediator who values harmony and clear communication. You have the rare ability to see multiple perspectives and help others feel heard. You show love by creating peace and facilitating understanding.
diplomat.full_description:
The Diplomat represents communication mastery, conflict resolution, and the pursuit of harmony. This archetype brings peace to chaos and understanding to confusion.

**Core Philosophy:** Most conflicts stem from miscommunication. With patience and empathy, almost anything can be resolved.

**What Drives Them:** A deep belief that harmony is achievable and that relationships thrive when both parties feel truly heard.
typical_behaviors: Naturally de-escalates tense situations
Asks clarifying questions before reacting
Can articulate others' perspectives accurately
Apologizes genuinely when wrong
Doesn't hold grudges after resolution
Creates space for difficult conversations
Validates feelings before problem-solving
Prefers private resolution over public conflict
green_flags: They pause before responding in heated moments
They say 'I understand why you feel that way' authentically
They take responsibility for their part in conflicts
They check in after disagreements to ensure resolution
They never use past mistakes as ammunition
diplomat.shadow_warning: You may be drawn to dominating personalities who mistake your harmony-seeking for weakness, creating an imbalanced dynamic.

visionary.name: The Torchbearer
visionary.subtitle: Purpose & Ambition
visionary.ideal_partner_description: You want a dreamer with a plan. This person has big visions for the future, is driven by purpose, and wants to make an impact on the world alongside you.
visionary.self_description: You are driven by purpose and the desire to make a meaningful impact. You have big visions for your life and need a partner who shares your ambition. You show love by including your partner in your dreams and supporting theirs.
visionary.full_description:
The Torchbearer represents purpose, ambition, and the drive to create meaningful change. This archetype sees the big picture and inspires others to dream bigger.

**Core Philosophy:** Life should be about more than just existing. We're here to create, contribute, and leave the world better than we found it.

**What Drives Them:** A deep sense of purpose and the belief that their life should have significant meaning and impact.
typical_behaviors: Talks passionately about future plans and goals
Connects daily actions to larger purpose
Inspired by causes and movements
Comfortable with unconventional paths
Sets ambitious goals and works toward them
Seeks partners who have their own passions
Willing to sacrifice comfort for purpose
Thinks in terms of legacy and impact
green_flags: They have clear goals they're actively pursuing
They're genuinely interested in your ambitions
They make time for what matters despite busy schedules
They can articulate why their work/passion matters
They support your growth even when inconvenient for them
visionary.shadow_warning: You may be drawn to overly practical partners who dismiss your dreams as unrealistic, slowly eroding your sense of purpose.
visionary.love_language: Acts of Service / Words of Affirmation

counter_type.name: The Drifter
counter_type.description: Lives without clear direction or purpose

empath|rock.description: A deeply committed traditionalist who views relationships as sacred, lifelong projects. They build homes, families, and shared histories.
empath|rock.ideal_partner_narrative: You're seeking someone who wants to build something lasting together—a home, a family, a shared legacy that deepens with every passing year.
empath|rock.self_narrative: You are a committed partner who views relationships as sacred investments. You build stability through consistent presence and show love through reliable action.

challenger|rock.description: Partners focused on building a legacy or high-achieving lifestyle, combining stability with intellectual ambition.
challenger|rock.ideal_partner_narrative: You're looking for someone to build an empire with—intellectual equals who share your drive to create something significant.
challenger|rock.self_narrative: You are a strategic partner who combines reliability with intellectual curiosity. You build thoughtfully and push your partner toward excellence.

adventurer|challenger.description: An intellectual powerhouse comfortable anywhere from black-tie galas to backpacking adventures. Life is about expansion.
adventurer|challenger.ideal_partner_narrative: You want someone who challenges your mind and expands your world—a partner for debates, adventures, and pushing boundaries together.
adventurer|challenger.self_narrative: You are a dynamic partner who brings intellectual depth and adventurous spirit. You keep life exciting while maintaining meaningful substance.

challenger|empath.description: A deeply conscious partner prioritizing mental and emotional health. Low-drama but high-depth.
challenger|empath.ideal_partner_narrative: You seek someone who values both emotional depth and intellectual growth—a partner for wine-soaked conversations about life's big questions.
challenger|empath.self_narrative: You are a thoughtful partner who combines emotional intelligence with intellectual curiosity. You create depth in relationships through meaningful dialogue.

adventurer|empath.description: Free-spirited partners focused on feelings, experiences, and living in the moment. Passion meets spontaneity.
adventurer|empath.ideal_partner_narrative: You want someone who feels deeply and lives fully—a partner for spontaneous adventures and profound conversations under the stars.
adventurer|empath.self_narrative: You are a passionate partner who combines emotional depth with love of experience. You create meaning through shared adventures and authentic connection.

adventurer|rock.description: Someone who provides stability while embracing new experiences. Reliable but never boring.
adventurer|rock.ideal_partner_narrative: You want someone who offers security without sacrificing excitement—a partner with both savings and a bucket list.
adventurer|rock.self_narrative: You are a balanced partner who combines stability with spontaneity. You build a secure foundation that enables adventure.

diplomat|empath.description: Partners who create deeply harmonious, emotionally safe relationships. Masters of connection and peace.
diplomat|empath.ideal_partner_narrative: You seek someone who creates emotional safety through excellent communication and deep empathy—a true sanctuary.
diplomat|empath.self_narrative: You are a nurturing partner who creates harmonious, emotionally rich relationships. You excel at making others feel heard and valued.

diplomat|rock.description: Partners combining stability with communication mastery. They build lasting relationships through consistent, clear connection.
diplomat|rock.ideal_partner_narrative: You want someone reliable who also communicates beautifully—a partner who shows up and speaks up.
diplomat|rock.self_narrative: You are a dependable partner with excellent communication skills. You build trust through both consistency and clarity.

challenger|visionary.description: Two ambitious minds building something significant together. Intellectual equals with shared drive for impact.
challenger|visionary.ideal_partner_narrative: You seek a true equal—someone with big dreams, sharp mind, and the drive to make things happen alongside you.
challenger|visionary.self_narrative: You are an ambitious partner who combines vision with intellectual rigor. Together you don't just dream—you build.

adventurer|visionary.description: Partners who combine purpose with experience. Life is an adventure in service of something bigger.
adventurer|visionary.ideal_partner_narrative: You want someone who shares your drive for meaning and your love of experience—a partner for purposeful adventures.
adventurer|visionary.self_narrative: You are a purpose-driven partner who pursues meaning through experience. You inspire others to dream bigger and live fuller.

challenger|diplomat.description: Partners who combine intellectual depth with communication grace. They argue well and resolve better.
challenger|diplomat.ideal_partner_narrative: You seek someone who can engage your mind while maintaining harmony—intellectual sparring with mutual respect.
challenger|diplomat.self_narrative: You are an articulate partner who brings both intellectual curiosity and diplomatic skill. You navigate complex conversations with grace.

empath|visionary.description: Partners combining emotional depth with purposeful ambition. Deep feelings driving meaningful action.
empath|visionary.ideal_partner_narrative: You want someone who feels as deeply as they dream—a partner whose heart and ambition are equally engaged.
empath|visionary.self_narrative: You are a passionate partner who combines emotional depth with purposeful drive. Your feelings fuel your mission.
